enabled.description: Enable the hosted webchat GUI provider.

public_base_url.description: Public base URL used to derive backend and GUI routes.

mode.description: Delivery mode used by the runner.

route.description: Routing key or channel route used for outbound messages.

tenant_channel_id.description: Tenant-scoped channel identifier used for webchat routing.

base_url.description: Optional host base URL for push/websocket endpoints.

presentation_mode.description: Choose standalone hosted page or framework-independent Web Component embed mode.

brand_name.description: Operator-set brand name for the chat header, page title and footer. Empty keeps the skin's own name.

brand_logo_url.description: Absolute https:// URL of the header logo. Empty keeps the skin's own logo.

text_input_enabled.description: Whether the embedded Web Component should show the text input box.

auto_start_on_open.description: Send an empty opening turn when a conversation is created so the flow can render a welcome card. Switch off for agent-first workers, where nothing absorbs that turn and the agent answers an empty message.

nav_links.description: Top-menu links used by standalone mode.

oauth_enabled.description: Whether OAuth login is offered on the hosted GUI.

oauth_providers.description: JSON array of OAuth provider configurations, composed from the per-provider setup answers.

oauth_greentic_issuer.description: Issuer base URL for the Greentic identity provider.

oauth_greentic_client_id.description: Registered public OIDC client ID for the Greentic identity provider.

oidc_issuer.description: Pinned OIDC issuer for Direct Line chat-token verification.

oidc_audience.description: Expected aud claim on the access token.

oidc_required_scope.description: Scope the access token must carry.
